levels.name: At Water's Edge
levels.description: While donning the Ceremonial Garment created by Nereid's Ascension, the final Normal Attack in Sangonomiya Kokomi's combo will unleash a swimming fish to deal 30% of her Max HP as Hydro DMG. This DMG is not considered Normal Attack DMG.

levels.name: The Clouds Like Waves Rippling
levels.description: Sangonomiya Kokomi gains the following Healing Bonuses with regard to characters with 50% or less HP via the following methods: Kurage's Oath Bake-Kurage: 4.5% of Kokomi's Max HP. Nereid's Ascension Normal and Charged Attacks: 0.6% of Kokomi's Max HP.

levels.name: The Moon, A Ship O'er the Seas
levels.description: Increases the Level of Nereid's Ascension by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: The Moon Overlooks the Waters
levels.description: While donning the Ceremonial Garment created by Nereid's Ascension, Sangonomiya Kokomi's Normal Attack SPD is increased by 10%, and Normal Attacks that hit opponents will restore 0.8 Energy for her. This effect can occur once every 0.2s.

levels.name: All Streams Flow to the Sea
levels.description: Increases the Level of Kurage's Oath by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Sango Isshin
levels.description: While donning the Ceremonial Garment created by Nereid's Ascension, Sangonomiya Kokomi gains a 40% Hydro DMG Bonus for 4s when her Normal and Charged Attacks heal, or would heal, any party member with 80% or more HP.
